Common enzymes checked include **ALT** (alanine transaminase), **AST** (aspartate transaminase), **ALP** (alkaline phosphatase), and **GGT** (gamma-glutamyl transferase).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF171_HDrC6U51pfzxNuk3g18YiRQjhzsMN3yZ_pInQwUEm7g0L6Zco5MFJIqdhZszbRjK0O_gXSyGW1JwjDPJPmlr2kkmts87h3AfN5JX1Qn9HULl6jgNnfhgxZEqeotQ709LPhNf7QYjn1gTXPyXaS2FV29UQzAAUm95NWLXcFgydro)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF10EJlMsiyCBqw_FA8-jVFF42vz7s66Ocx5olLBxm9RiEGNiCYmKOwc-LMdz4987MXdkd0RYQ2oQxrPtUcZ6OuA-mxuGS8caIqhGnnKiEn_iUj_d1EDZ4MaQE54nO9rpYY8OSE_TMHLSP24r5C0GMJrRKjH9WIbcnwUD8aOmF50qpNLbbA2XGouqcrXrV)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1808_9wSlndXijpOCdHP9iOiBeGG65m-JwsqrSJU2Nv-IiN1f5u4Asw5FnVN7xCKwTrHZmpJZHhyPKlf9sPp48AtMbdZxlK0bpCzKjw601jGK-o50Y2YaCFsCJW-N_W903Rl2fDWV_MkT42HNLKqFQPKwptV54blGPKLyX9wubSUdh4rm_QbYApezxxQNdNQUj2F)

### Common Causes

Elevations can be brief and harmless or point to an underlying condition:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF10EJlMsiyCBqw_FA8-jVFF42vz7s66Ocx5olLBxm9RiEGNiCYmKOwc-LMdz4987MXdkd0RYQ2oQxrPtUcZ6OuA-mxuGS8caIqhGnnKiEn_iUj_d1EDZ4MaQE54nO9rpYY8OSE_TMHLSP24r5C0GMJrRKjH9WIbcnwUD8aOmF50qpNLbbA2XGouqcrXrV)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF171_HDrC6U51pfzxNuk3g18YiRQjhzsMN3yZ_pInQwUEm7g0L6Zco5MFJIqdhZszbRjK0O_gXSyGW1JwjDPJPmlr2kkmts87h3AfN5JX1Qn9HULl6jgNnfhgxZEqeotQ709LPhNf7QYjn1gTXPyXaS2FV29UQzAAUm95NWLXcFgydro)

- **Medications & supplements:** Prescription drugs (such as statins), over-the-counter pain relievers like acetaminophen, and herbal or dietary supplements.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXluX0yGH5toHqj_HhgWbBEv8EXMolrAveIUVwosWim-SR7nZSMoaqtohmyqzmtEzXf4Oi0QNcMOI8XbcfdNG-nqu1PEYpimfgRUnInfSKHlGDK3CjwFh5HW7iKU275_dVIJmw9i1ZSMoW99sqPFsR)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF10EJlMsiyCBqw_FA8-jVFF42vz7s66Ocx5olLBxm9RiEGNiCYmKOwc-LMdz4987MXdkd0RYQ2oQxrPtUcZ6OuA-mxuGS8caIqhGnnKiEn_iUj_d1EDZ4MaQE54nO9rpYY8OSE_TMHLSP24r5C0GMJrRKjH9WIbcnwUD8aOmF50qpNLbbA2XGouqcrXrV)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF12iUfVsFCYPRlvc6EatOjMK-zHglqTc-3bHfGhHmNjRJ9vPhoDMxi-n29Q7RFWKFZtIIwvK8YiNcnu-_YQvU-DdO5aDTbax5up78gUEOnIFBbu-0VhLasQ4S0WagihHOlxysS1gRdgAOGAN1rc5XEVA6p5TcNTJUNvrBZqP4KPSR906K1NrUD80GWLXlR7O-LVOGuO8rY2mbCk7cDrrnO3KvHgDMhSmos6kJps6Q)

### Symptoms and Next Steps
Many people have no symptoms at all, especially with mild or temporary increases. When symptoms do appear, they may include fatigue, nausea, loss of appetite, upper abdominal discomfort, dark urine, pale stools, or yellowing of the skin and eyes (jaundice).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX9H2L3ivNNoC1_Hlly7bxk2SGubcDUYGlFqI3nUAsQdTczRFgojQDnvtSwDVMTgzzeUiISYt4bEju4qerFfsKEYvQ1RQTogrBExeieU6oXdCPMQQmbERifIFly-veCEXllA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF12iUfVsFCYPRlvc6EatOjMK-zHglqTc-3bHfGhHmNjRJ9vPhoDMxi-n29Q7RFWKFZtIIwvK8YiNcnu-_YQvU-DdO5aDTbax5up78gUEOnIFBbu-0VhLasQ4S0WagihHOlxysS1gRdgAOGAN1rc5XEVA6p5TcNTJUNvrBZqP4KPSR906K1NrUD80GWLXlR7O-LVOGuO8rY2mbCk7cDrrnO3KvHgDMhSmos6kJps6Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1808_9wSlndXijpOCdHP9iOiBeGG65m-JwsqrSJU2Nv-IiN1f5u4Asw5FnVN7xCKwTrHZmpJZHhyPKlf9sPp48AtMbdZxlK0bpCzKjw601jGK-o50Y2YaCFsCJW-N_W903Rl2fDWV_MkT42HNLKqFQPKwptV54blGPKLyX9wubSUdh4rm_QbYApezxxQNdNQUj2F)Doctors often repeat blood tests after a few weeks to see if levels settle on their own. Depending on the pattern and degree of elevation, further evaluation may include targeted blood work, a review of all medications and supplements, or an abdominal ultrasound. Seek prompt medical care if results come with jaundice, severe abdominal pain, confusion, or very high enzyme spikes.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF171_HDrC6U51pfzxNuk3g18YiRQjhzsMN3yZ_pInQwUEm7g0L6Zco5MFJIqdhZszbRjK0O_gXSyGW1JwjDPJPmlr2kkmts87h3AfN5JX1Qn9HULl6jgNnfhgxZEqeotQ709LPhNf7QYjn1gTXPyXaS2FV29UQzAAUm95NWLXcFgydro)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF12iUfVsFCYPRlvc6EatOjMK-zHglqTc-3bHfGhHmNjRJ9vPhoDMxi-n29Q7RFWKFZtIIwvK8YiNcnu-_YQvU-DdO5aDTbax5up78gUEOnIFBbu-0VhLasQ4S0WagihHOlxysS1gRdgAOGAN1rc5XEVA6p5TcNTJUNvrBZqP4KPSR906K1NrUD80GWLXlR7O-LVOGuO8rY2mbCk7cDrrnO3KvHgDMhSmos6kJps6Q)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX9H2L3ivNNoC1_Hlly7bxk2SGubcDUYGlFqI3nUAsQdTczRFgojQDnvtSwDVMTgzzeUiISYt4bEju4qerFfsKEYvQ1RQTogrBExeieU6oXdCPMQQmbERifIFly-veCEXllA)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D8E4S0dtlGI&t=25)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF1808_9wSlndXijpOCdHP9iOiBeGG65m-JwsqrSJU2Nv-IiN1f5u4Asw5FnVN7xCKwTrHZmpJZHhyPKlf9sPp48AtMbdZxlK0bpCzKjw601jGK-o50Y2YaCFsCJW-N_W903Rl2fDWV_MkT42HNLKqFQPKwptV54blGPKLyX9wubSUdh4rm_QbYApezxxQNdNQUj2F)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpAEBxCJF1ztjVdv2aG1nzqHU0jAHmJR2IDv7gUU0gtwl8rOmSzWZSyFSKIsgHBv3l38F-DJtu9jV2qbLH28OuODlQktGsrl0pqe3X6BjXQ3WDQzVE4_G_bRX8rlgbxCejzJg-ab5YTFqLcFfgtUPW69FOFG1Zu7yTvkmYBewHnljRRO2qAGYdXCiaZ_3TguNz_KZlw8BlaSPghsRSxsIpVv3Vre9jQ)[[7]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Z_ePxq4yZs&t=320)For items.text: Doctors often repeat blood tests after a few weeks to see if levels settle on their own. Depending on the pattern and degree of elevation, further evaluation may include targeted blood work, a review of all medications and supplements, or an abdominal ultrasound. Seek prompt medical care if results come with jaundice, severe abdominal pain, confusion, or very high enzyme spikes.
